# Discussion questions



- How may the engagement with AI harm the development of ideas?
  - Think about the goals of the design of the tool vs. your own particular goals (pointer to Interaction)
- How does human-to-human interaction fundamentally differ from human-AI interaction?
- How are GenAI models trained to produce and “learn” language? How does this differ from how a child learns language?

- What is the difference between regarding research as a process rather than as a product? Why should “serendipity” matter to this process? (LD)
